usage: wtune.py predict [-h] [--namelist NAMELIST] --nodes NODES
                        [--config CONFIG] [--ranks RANKS] [--omp OMP]
                        [--nx NX] [--ny NY] [--numtiles NUMTILES]
                        [--dist {block,cyclic}] [--probe PROBE]
                        [--probe-rsl PROBE_RSL] [--case-name CASE_NAME]
                        [--calibration CALIBRATION] [--io-form {2,11,14}]
                        [--io-target {nfs,local}] [--include-io]
                        [--iofields-dir IOFIELDS_DIR] [--json JSON]
                        case_dir

positional arguments:
  case_dir              directory with namelist.input (+ optional
                        wrfinput_d0N/wrfbdy_d0N)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --namelist NAMELIST   explicit namelist.input path (default:
                        <case_dir>/namelist.input)
  --nodes NODES         number of nodes
  --config CONFIG       JSON blob or path: {ranks,omp,nx,ny,numtiles}
  --ranks RANKS         total MPI ranks (default nx*ny)
  --omp OMP             OMP threads per rank (default 1)
  --nx NX               nproc_x
  --ny NY               nproc_y
  --numtiles NUMTILES   numtiles (default 1)
  --dist {block,cyclic}
                        srun/mpirun rank distribution (block or cyclic; NOT
                        defaulted -- if omitted and --config has no 'dist',
                        the launch line prints dist=UNKNOWN and omits --rank-
                        by rather than guessing)
  --probe PROBE         strict_campaign ledger CSV (repeatable)
  --probe-rsl PROBE_RSL
                        path to a probe run's rsl.error.0000 (repeatable);
                        measures r_rad (and, when --probe gives no matching
                        ledger row, s_normal) from the probe's own d01 step
                        timings instead of the hard-coded r_rad default (see
                        measure_rad_from_rsl -- ASSUMES the probe window has
                        no mid-run history/restart writes)
  --case-name CASE_NAME
                        the case's ledger identity (case_base in --probe's
                        CSV), when it differs from case_dir's own basename
                        (default: case_dir's basename) -- e.g. a case whose
                        prep dir is /nfs/data/wrf/doi4-lafe2017 but whose
                        ledger case_base is 'lafe'; without this, --probe rows
                        for that case silently fail to match and prediction
                        falls back to no_probe_fallback
  --calibration CALIBRATION
                        calibration JSON (default
                        machine/calibration/scc.json)
  --io-form {2,11,14}   override io_form_history (default: read from namelist)
  --io-target {nfs,local}
                        write target (default nfs; local is UNMEASURED)
  --include-io          add the history I/O estimate to TOTAL and its range
                        (off by default: the write rate is not predictable
                        enough, see build_prediction)
  --iofields-dir IOFIELDS_DIR
                        directory holding the real iofields_filename field-
                        list file(s) (default: case_dir); used to size field-
                        subset aux streams exactly
  --json JSON           also write the full prediction as JSON to this path

help-top.stdout:
usage: wtune.py [-h] [--version]
                {plan,hotspot,physics,knobs,catalog,audit,screen,profile,machine-profile,oracle-map,restart-window,feedback,selftest,compliance,predict,tune,config,metdata,check,calibrate,post,prep,project,analyze,predict-rebuild,watch,run,convert,advise,calc,scenario}
                ...

WRF config autotuner analytical core

positional arguments:
  {plan,hotspot,physics,knobs,catalog,audit,screen,profile,machine-profile,oracle-map,restart-window,feedback,selftest,compliance,predict,tune,config,metdata,check,calibrate,post,prep,project,analyze,predict-rebuild,watch,run,convert,advise,calc,scenario}
    plan                generate ranked decomposition shortlist
    hotspot             physics load map: analytic terminator + convective
                        surrogate
    physics             physics diagnosis + numerics advice + scheme menu
    knobs               full knob advisor: input-derived param recommendations
                        + mismatch flags
    catalog             list the complete Registry-derived parameter catalog
    audit               Registry-driven scan of EVERY (2062) catalog param
                        (coverage guarantee, any WRF case)
    screen              autotuner funnel: analytic screen (all params) ->
                        SpeedyWeather vet -> effective few
    profile             case-understanding profile (PRIOR, pre-measurement):
                        identity/physics/cost-structure/imbalance/core-count
                        priors
    machine-profile     print a human summary of a
                        machine/run_machine_profile.sh JSON (MEASURED machine
                        speed, not the case profile)
    oracle-map          DIAGNOSTIC spatial physics-load map (per-cell phase
                        cost + hotspots); NOT a partition selector
    restart-window      UNVERIFIED restart-boundary decomposition/team
                        hypotheses
    feedback            manifest-only advisory feedback decisions
    selftest            run CONUS calibration self-test
    compliance          compliance model + knob catalog (decision 0050):
                        validate/list/classify
    predict             predict per-stage + total wall time for a WRF run,
                        without running it
    tune                budgeted on-cluster tuner (scc): probe, screen,
                        confirm, report
    config              wtune tune search-space YAML config (wtune_config.py):
                        init | show | validate
    metdata             GRIB source selection/availability/download
                        (tools/metdata.py): find | check | fetch
    check               pre-submission WRF run_dir sanity checker
                        (wtune_preflight.py): time windows, iofields, physics
                        data files, decomposition, disk
    calibrate           machine calibration for a new cluster
                        (wtune_calibrate.py plan | fit)
    post                post-processing/analysis, advisory only (decision
                        0056; post/cli.py): inventory | extract | plot |
                        sounding | tc | compare | report | recipe | custom
    prep                optional input-data preparation, user-invoked only
                        (decision 0063; wtune_geog.py): geog list | fetch |
                        import-dem | verify | bounds | srtm-fetch
    project             project folder holding case/input/config/runs/post
                        (decision 0058; wtune_project.py): init | info | set
    analyze             TC diagnostics/tracking via wrf-python +
                        TempestExtremes (analysis/cli.py): diag | tc-track
    predict-rebuild     whole-run wall-time prediction from rebuilt segments
                        measured in parallel on the target config
                        (wtune_rebuild_predict.py)
    watch               read-only monitor of a WRF run dir: progress,
                        remaining time, hang/nest-stop/failure warnings
                        (wtune_watch.py)
    run                 segmented WRF execution with restart hand-offs, per-
                        segment config and opt-in CFL rescue (wtune_run.py)
    convert             WRF netCDF <-> ADIOS2 BP (io_form 14) conversion
                        (wtune_bp.py): nc2bp | bp2nc | inputs (cached,
                        manifest) [--check round trip]
    advise              advice-only: detect case conditions and suggest WRF
                        modes/workflows with cost, evidence and side effects
                        (decision 0061; wtune_advise.py)
    calc                rules of thumb and unit conversions for namelist
                        parameters, plus `calc check <namelist.input>`
                        (decision 0062; wtune_calc.py)
    scenario            pluggable scenario generators for fictional-date WRF
                        forcing (scenario/cli.py): list | generate | inspect

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

  {plan,hotspot,physics,knobs,catalog,audit,screen,profile,machine-profile,oracle-map,restart-window,feedback,selftest,compliance,predict,tune,config,metdata,check,calibrate,post,prep,project,analyze,predict-rebuild,watch,run,convert,advise,calc,scenario}
    plan                generate ranked decomposition shortlist
    hotspot             physics load map: analytic terminator + convective
                        surrogate
    physics             physics diagnosis + numerics advice + scheme menu
    knobs               full knob advisor: input-derived param recommendations
                        + mismatch flags
    catalog             list the complete Registry-derived parameter catalog
    audit               Registry-driven scan of EVERY (2062) catalog param
                        (coverage guarantee, any WRF case)
    screen              autotuner funnel: analytic screen (all params) ->
                        SpeedyWeather vet -> effective few
    profile             case-understanding profile (PRIOR, pre-measurement):
                        identity/physics/cost-structure/imbalance/core-count
                        priors
    machine-profile     print a human summary of a
                        machine/run_machine_profile.sh JSON (MEASURED machine
                        speed, not the case profile)
    oracle-map          DIAGNOSTIC spatial physics-load map (per-cell phase
                        cost + hotspots); NOT a partition selector
    restart-window      UNVERIFIED restart-boundary decomposition/team
                        hypotheses
    feedback            manifest-only advisory feedback decisions
    selftest            run CONUS calibration self-test
    compliance          compliance model + knob catalog (decision 0050):
                        validate/list/classify
    predict             predict per-stage + total wall time for a WRF run,
                        without running it
    tune                budgeted on-cluster tuner (scc): probe, screen,
                        confirm, report
    config              wtune tune search-space YAML config (wtune_config.py):
                        init | show | validate
    metdata             GRIB source selection/availability/download
                        (tools/metdata.py): find | check | fetch
    check               pre-submission WRF run_dir sanity checker
                        (wtune_preflight.py): time windows, iofields, physics
                        data files, decomposition, disk
    calibrate           machine calibration for a new cluster
                        (wtune_calibrate.py plan | fit)
    post                post-processing/analysis, advisory only (decision
                        0056; post/cli.py): inventory | extract | plot |
                        sounding | tc | compare | report | recipe | custom
    prep                optional input-data preparation, user-invoked only
                        (decision 0063; wtune_geog.py): geog list | fetch |
                        import-dem | verify | bounds | srtm-fetch
    project             project folder holding case/input/config/runs/post
                        (decision 0058; wtune_project.py): init | info | set
    analyze             TC diagnostics/tracking via wrf-python +
                        TempestExtremes (analysis/cli.py): diag | tc-track
    predict-rebuild     whole-run wall-time prediction from rebuilt segments
                        measured in parallel on the target config
                        (wtune_rebuild_predict.py)
    watch               read-only monitor of a WRF run dir: progress,
                        remaining time, hang/nest-stop/failure warnings
                        (wtune_watch.py)
    run                 segmented WRF execution with restart hand-offs, per-
                        segment config and opt-in CFL rescue (wtune_run.py)
    convert             WRF netCDF <-> ADIOS2 BP (io_form 14) conversion
                        (wtune_bp.py): nc2bp | bp2nc | inputs (cached,
                        manifest) [--check round trip]
    advise              advice-only: detect case conditions and suggest WRF
                        modes/workflows with cost, evidence and side effects
                        (decision 0061; wtune_advise.py)
    calc                rules of thumb and unit conversions for namelist
                        parameters, plus `calc check <namelist.input>`
                        (decision 0062; wtune_calc.py)
    scenario            pluggable scenario generators for fictional-date WRF
                        forcing (scenario/cli.py): list | generate | inspect

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
